rows.name: Deaths during or following police contact: 2025/26 release metadata
rows.semantic_limit: The confirmed release metadata identifies scope and reporting period but does not itself provide case-level findings or establish risk at a police force, address, person or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The accredited official statistics announcement confirms a 30 July 2026 release covering deaths during or following police contact between 1 April 2025 and 31 March 2026.

rows.name: Safety in custody: quarterly update to March 2026 release metadata
rows.semantic_limit: Release metadata describes prison-custody deaths, self-harm and assaults at England-and-Wales level; it is not evidence of conditions at a particular prison wing, person, address or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The accredited official statistics announcement confirms a 30 July 2026 release covering deaths, self-harm and assaults in prison custody.

rows.name: Safety in the Children and Young People Secure Estate: update to March 2026 release metadata
rows.publisher: Ministry of Justice and Youth Custody Service
rows.semantic_limit: Release metadata covers assaults, self-harm, separations, use of force and deaths in the secure estate; it cannot be converted into a child-level, institution-level or parcel-level prediction.
rows.evidence_basis: The official statistics announcement confirms a 30 July 2026 release for the children and young people secure estate.

rows.name: Youth custody data: May 2026
rows.publisher: HM Prison and Probation Service and Youth Custody Service
rows.semantic_limit: Custody population breakdowns are establishment, demographic and regional statistics; they do not establish individual risk or exact safety conditions at a facility or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official monthly series published May 2026 data on the population and characteristics of children and young people in the secure estate.

rows.name: Prison population monthly figures: June 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Population totals describe prison-estate capacity context and cannot be used as a direct proxy for violence, safety, local crime or parcel risk.
rows.evidence_basis: The official transparency series published monthly prison population figures for June 2026.

rows.name: Police use of firearms statistics, April 2025 to March 2026
rows.semantic_limit: National and police-force-area firearms-operation statistics do not establish threat, response likelihood or safety at a specific incident, address or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official release covers firearms operations, armed response vehicles, discharges and authorised firearms officers for England and Wales.

rows.name: Firearm and shotgun certificates, April 2025 to March 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Certificate counts and holder characteristics are licensing statistics and must not be treated as evidence of firearm presence, misuse or risk at a household or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official release covers firearm and shotgun certificates, certificate holders, weapon types, dealers, permits and force-level data.
